criteria.requirement: Rename the tool from old-name to new-name everywhere it is delivered, including packaging and site navigation.
criteria.expected_outcome: No tracked file, package metadata field or navigation entry contains old-name, and the installed package is named new-name.

criteria.requirement: Retire the legacy-sync service; nothing may recreate it.
criteria.expected_outcome: legacy-sync and the timer that recreated it are both inactive and disabled on the target host.

criteria.requirement: The user guide names new-name in every section that named old-name.
criteria.expected_outcome: An editorial review of the final candidate finds no section that still names old-name.

criteria.not_applicable_reason: The project ships no Windows installer; the issue template lists it for every rename.
